RATTLE_DRUM.name: Rattle Drum
RATTLE_DRUM.effect: On Summon: +3 Count for each BONE die that scores.
RATTLE_DRUM.lore: Skin of a tambourine, sticks of a femur. Skeletons dance to it involuntarily.

EMBER_JAR.name: Ember Jar
EMBER_JAR.effect: On Summon: +20 Power for each FIRE die that scores.
EMBER_JAR.lore: Do not open indoors. Do not open outdoors either.

FROST_LANTERN.name: Frost Lantern
FROST_LANTERN.effect: On Summon, if a scoring die is ICE: +5 Power per scoring die.
FROST_LANTERN.lore: Burns cold and blue. Moths file complaints.

MOSS_CHARM.name: Moss Charm
MOSS_CHARM.effect: On Summon: +2 Count for each LEAF die that scores.
MOSS_CHARM.lore: Grows a little every time you are not looking.

LIGHTNING_ROD.name: Lightning Rod
LIGHTNING_ROD.effect: On Summon: +10 Power and +1 Count for each VOLT die that scores.
LIGHTNING_ROD.lore: Attracts storms, ghosts and the occasional angry wizard.

IRON_NAIL.name: Iron Nail
IRON_NAIL.effect: On Summon, with 2+ METAL dice scoring: +30 Power.
IRON_NAIL.lore: Pulled from a coffin. The coffin wants it back.

GRAVEDIGGER_LAMP.name: Gravedigger's Lamp
GRAVEDIGGER_LAMP.lore: Lights the way to every grave. Some of them are occupied.

TRIO_TOTEM.name: Trio Totem
TRIO_TOTEM.effect: On Summon of a Trio: +8 Count.
TRIO_TOTEM.lore: Three faces, one opinion: more skeletons.

MOON_CHARM.name: Moon Charm
MOON_CHARM.effect: On Summon of a Full Moon: +10 Count.
MOON_CHARM.lore: Hums softly when the moon is full and loudly when it is not.

BONE_SAW.name: Bone Saw
BONE_SAW.effect: On Summon, if every scoring die shows 4+ points: +40 Power.
BONE_SAW.lore: Only cuts through the very best bones.

WISP_JAR.name: Wisp Jar
WISP_JAR.effect: On Summon of a Rabble: x3 Count.
WISP_JAR.lore: A jar of leftover wisps. They are fine with it.

GRAVE_ROBBER.name: Grave Robber
GRAVE_ROBBER.lore: A sack, a shovel and a flexible attitude toward property.

DEEP_FREEZE.name: Deep Freeze
DEEP_FREEZE.effect: On Summon, with 3+ ICE dice scoring: x1.5 Count.
DEEP_FREEZE.lore: A skull frozen in an ice cube. It is still thinking.

LOADED_BONE.name: Loaded Bone
LOADED_BONE.effect: On Roll: if no BONE shows, one die flips to its BONE face.
LOADED_BONE.lore: Weighted with lead and a little cheating.

THRIFTY_GHOST.name: Thrifty Ghost
THRIFTY_GHOST.effect: On Summon: +3 Count for each Reroll you still have.
THRIFTY_GHOST.lore: Saves every coin. Has nothing to spend it on. Being dead is cheap.

HYBRID_VIGOR.name: Hybrid Vigor
HYBRID_VIGOR.effect: On Summon of a Duo Pact or Full Moon: +6 Count.
HYBRID_VIGOR.lore: Two potions in one bottle. Shake before summoning.

COPYCAT_COFFIN.name: Copycat Coffin
COPYCAT_COFFIN.effect: On Summon of a monster already in your army: +8 Count.
COPYCAT_COFFIN.lore: Two identical coffins. Nobody knows which one is the original.

OVERGROWTH.name: Overgrowth
OVERGROWTH.effect: On Summon: +1 Count for every LEAF squad you ever summoned (now +{counter}).
OVERGROWTH.lore: A vine that remembers every leaf it has ever met.

SPIRIT_BOARD.name: Spirit Board
SPIRIT_BOARD.effect: On Summon of a Rainbow: x2 Count.
SPIRIT_BOARD.lore: Spells out R-A-I-N-B-O-W, then goes very quiet.

PIGGY_COFFIN.name: Piggy Coffin
PIGGY_COFFIN.effect: On Summon: +2 Power for each $1 you hold.
PIGGY_COFFIN.lore: A piggy bank shaped like a coffin. Oink, rest in peace.

GILDED_TOOTH.name: Gilded Tooth
GILDED_TOOTH.effect: On Summon: earn $1 for each BONE die that scores.
GILDED_TOOTH.lore: Pulled from a pirate skeleton. The pirate is still looking.

BONE_PILE.name: Bone Pile
BONE_PILE.effect: On Summon: +2 Count for each unpicked die showing BONE.
BONE_PILE.lore: Just a pile of bones. Probably. Do not count them.

COLD_HEARTH.name: Cold Hearth
COLD_HEARTH.effect: On Summon: +15 Power for each scoring die with 1-2 points.
COLD_HEARTH.lore: A fireplace that went out centuries ago and is still sulking.

GRAND_PROCESSION.name: Grand Procession
GRAND_PROCESSION.effect: On Summon: +15 Power for each squad already in your army.
GRAND_PROCESSION.lore: A tiny banner that makes every march feel important.

TACTICIAN_SKULL.name: Tactician's Skull
TACTICIAN_SKULL.effect: On your first Summon of a battle: x2 Power.
TACTICIAN_SKULL.lore: Wore a general's helmet once. Still gives orders.

CROWN_OF_THE_LICH.name: Crown of the Lich
CROWN_OF_THE_LICH.effect: On Summon of a Ritual, Quartet or Quintet: x2 Count.
CROWN_OF_THE_LICH.lore: Heavy is the head that wears it. Heavier when the head is a skull.

LAST_RITES.name: Last Rites
LAST_RITES.effect: On your last Summon of a battle: x3 Count.
LAST_RITES.lore: Spoken once, at the very end. Loudly.

ELEMENTAL_CONVERGENCE.name: Elemental Convergence
ELEMENTAL_CONVERGENCE.effect: On Summon, once all 6 elements have scored this battle: x3 Count.
ELEMENTAL_CONVERGENCE.lore: Six coloured stones that only glow together.

BLOOD_MOON.name: Blood Moon
BLOOD_MOON.effect: On Attack, with 3+ squads: x1.5 damage.
BLOOD_MOON.lore: When it rises, everything hits a little harder.

BLACK_GRIMOIRE.name: Black Grimoire
BLACK_GRIMOIRE.effect: On Attack: x1 damage, +0.25 for each boss defeated (now x{value}).
BLACK_GRIMOIRE.lore: Lists every boss you have ever beaten, in alphabetical order.
